scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, what business are you here for?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
你好，請問有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you wish to join the Illusion Investigation Corps, you're lacking in skills yet.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
如果你想加入<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊，你的技能還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please visit again when you have reached a certain level.

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, I'm Joel, the Commander of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
你好，我是<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊的指揮官，喬爾。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Have you ever heard of or experienced illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
你聽說過或者經歷過<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺嗎？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Until now, illusions have been discovered all over the world and are somewhat known to the public.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
迄今為止，<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺已在世界各地被發現，公眾對此也有一定了解。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It is also used as a hunting ground for many adventurers because it is easy to obtain rare materials.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
由於容易獲取稀有材料，它也被許多冒險者用作狩獵場。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Also, the monsters in Illusion are new monsters that have never been discovered before, and the monsters in Illusion are multiplying abnormally.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
此外，<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺中的魔物是以前從未發現過的新魔物，而且它們的數量正在異常增加。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Despite many adventurers hunting the monsters that exist in Illusion to obtain materials, the reason for the very rapid recovery of the population has not been identified.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
儘管許多冒險者為了獲取材料而狩獵<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺中的魔物，但其數量恢復極快的原因仍未查明。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Our Illusion Investigation Team was organized to uncover the mystery of the Illusion, and first we decided to figure out the ecology of the monsters inside the Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
我們的<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊是為了揭開<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺的秘密而成立的，首先我們決定弄清其中魔物的生態。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
What we found was that all illusions are affected by dimensional rifts.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
我們發現，所有的<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺都受到次元裂縫的影響。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I've been speculating that it might be related to the dimensional rift for a long time, but with the results of this investigation, it's clear.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
我長期以來一直猜測這可能與次元裂縫有關，但根據這次調查的結果，這一點已經非常明確。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
There are still many adventurers visiting Illusion with a purpose, so the monster population is fortunately maintained.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
由於仍有許多冒險者帶著目的前往<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺，魔物數量得以維持，這是萬幸。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If no one sets foot there, it's very dangerous because the monsters can go beyond saturation and invade other areas.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
如果沒人踏足那裡，魔物數量可能會超過飽和併入侵其他區域，那將非常危險。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
For that reason, the number of individuals is still being investigated, and one investigator is currently assigned to each illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
因此，目前仍在調查個體數量，每個<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺都指派了一名調查員。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And we're recruiting members with the ability to control the number of monsters inside Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
我們正在招募能夠控制<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺內魔物數量的成員。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And if you're an adventurer, you seem to be strong enough for that role...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
而且，作為冒險者，你似乎足夠強大，能夠勝任這個角色...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Would you like to join the Illusion Investigation Team and join us in investigating illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
你願意加入<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊，與我們一起調查<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺嗎？

scripts.text: I'm joining
scripts.translation: 我要加入

scripts.text: I'll think about it
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It's very meaningful.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
這非常有意義。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please think about it before you tell me.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
請考慮清楚後再告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Okay, you're welcome!!
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
好的，歡迎加入！！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
The procedure is simple, please fill out the pledge here...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
手續很簡單，請在這裡填寫誓詞...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Here... please sign this.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
請在這裡... 籤一下名。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
..
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
..

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Yes, with this you have become a member of the Illusionary Survey Corps, welcome again!
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
是的，至此你已成為<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊的成員，再次歡迎你！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you have time during your adventure, I would like you to stop by the Illusions located in various places and help me with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
如果你在冒險期間有空，請前往各地出現的<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺，協助我們進行調查。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
A dispatched investigator will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
派出的調查員會指引你。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Then I hope you have a nice day
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
那麼，祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I think the investigation will be much easier thanks to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
多虧了你，冒險者，我想調查工作會輕鬆許多。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
New illusions will appear again.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
新的<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺還會再次出現。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Every new discovery takes a lot of time for us to adapt to it
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
每一次新發現都需要我們花費大量時間去適應。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
This investigation will at least help reduce that time.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
這項調查至少能幫助我們縮短這段時間。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Thank you and look forward to many more activities in the future.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 喬爾]
謝謝你，期待未來有更多活動。

Hello~~!!
scripts.translation:

The Illusion Investigation Corps is getting bigger little by little.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
The more members, the more things we can do, right?
scripts.translation:

成員越多，我們能做的事情就越多，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Hello, I'm Zenian, a new member of the team.
scripts.translation:
[成員 澤尼安]
你好，我是澤尼安，隊伍的新成員。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
I've been paying attention to the phenomenon of dimensional rifts for a long time. Clearly, despite many subjugations, monsters are constantly appearing.
scripts.translation:
[成員 澤尼安]
我一直都在關注次元裂縫的現象。很明顯，儘管我們進行了多次討伐，魔物卻仍在不斷出現。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
It has been proven that this phenomenon also occurs in illusions, so I decided to join the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[成員 澤尼安]
已經證實這種現象也會發生在<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺中，所以我決定加入<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Good luck in the future!!
scripts.translation:
[成員 澤尼安]
祝你們未來一切順利！！

scripts.text:

Nice to meet you, this is the Welcome Survey Team.
scripts.translation:

很高興見到你，這裡是歡迎調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Investigate the ecosystem of monsters in Illusion...

[成員 林克]
調查<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺中魔物的生態系統...

scripts.text:
[Member link]

[成員 林克]

scripts.text:
[Member link]
I hope that everyone who is working hard at this time will return safely without any incident.
scripts.translation:
[成員 林克]
希望此刻正在為此努力工作的大家都能平安歸來，不要發生任何意外。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你好！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]

[Girocker]

scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你好！！

[Girocker]
I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
我是<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查隊的J-吉羅克。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ugh... To come to a place like this...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
唉...來到這種地方...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I usually pretended to be brave, but I think I was conscious of Elysia, the member I have a crush on.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
我平時總是假裝很勇敢，但我覺得是因為在意伊莉西亞，那個我暗戀的成員。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Actually, I'm the one who's more timid than anyone else... heck
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
其實，我才是那個比誰都膽小的人...真是的

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Anyway... I'm in charge of investigating this place.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
總之...我負責調查這個地方。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Have you heard about the investigation from Captain Joel? Adventurer, you have to completely hunt 100 monsters by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你從指揮官 喬爾那裡聽說過調查的事嗎？冒險者，你必須獨自完全討伐100只魔物。

scripts.text:

Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?

你願意參與這裡的調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate

[Girocker]
Then should I ask another adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
那我去問問其他冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
只要在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
那麼，請小心！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ah, that's enough for today's investigation.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
啊，今天的調查就到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
It will be restored tomorrow, so if you can afford it, I would appreciate it if you could come and help me with the investigation!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
明天會重置，如果你方便的話，希望能再來幫我調查！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你好，你今天來幫忙調查嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
The content is the same as last time.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
內容和上次一樣。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物，你願意參與嗎？

scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

It would be nice if you could help me today...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
如果你今天能幫我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
太好了！！

scripts.text:

Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
只要在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
那麼，請小心！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
You're back safely!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你平安回來了！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Okay... Then hmm... I'll have to wait and see how much monsters spawn for a while.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
好吧...那麼嗯...我得先觀察一下魔物的重新整理情況。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Leave the rest to me!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
剩下的交給我！！謝謝！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Oh, must you have a hard time enduring the cold here?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
哦，你一定很難忍受這裡的寒冷吧？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Come back when you're a little hotter.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
等你暖和一點再回來吧。

你好~

scripts.translation:

It's really cold here...

I'd like to ask the adventurer for help...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

如果不介意的話，要不要加入<黑暗蒐集者>調查隊？這樣你就可以幫我了！！!

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
我是<黑暗蒐集者>調查隊的伊莉西亞~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's really cold here...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
這裡真的好冷啊...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I never thought I would be sent to such a dangerous place alone... I wanted to come with Jirocker...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
沒想到我會被單獨派到這麼危險的地方...我想和吉羅克一起來的...

Well, even if there was a Jirocker, he's a coward, so I'd be in a position to protect him...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
嗯，就算有吉羅克在，他也是個膽小鬼，到時候反而得我來保護他...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
You pretended to be brave... but I already noticed
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你假裝很勇敢...但我已經看出來了

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Is Jirocker doing his investigation safely in the abandoned village? I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
吉羅克在廢棄村莊裡安全地進行調查嗎？我很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hmm... Actually, now is not the time to worry about Jirocker, Adventurer. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
嗯...其實，現在不是擔心吉羅克的時候，冒險者。你能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]

scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你聽說過這次調查是關於魔物數量維持的嗎？很多冒險者來這裡打獵，但數量有點不夠。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's easy to figure out the number of monsters when you deal with them hotly. How about you? Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
在激烈戰鬥時很容易統計魔物的數量。你呢？想不想參與這裡的調查？

scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Yeah, that's right...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
嗯，沒錯...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll be shivering a little longer...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
那我還要再冷一會兒了...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Oh yes!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
太好了！！謝謝！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
進入後，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I look forward to your hot hunting skills~~!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
期待你火熱的狩獵技巧~~！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, I think this should be enough for today!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
啊，我想今天這樣就夠了！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you come after tomorrow, you'll have something else to do~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
如果你明天再來，就有別的事情要做了~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, nice to meet you!! Are you here today to help with the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
啊，很高興見到你！！你今天來是協助調查的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Your help is the same as last time~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你的幫助和上次一樣~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
如果你能擊殺100只任意種類的魔物，願意參加嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Okay... I'll keep shivering in the cold...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
好吧...我會在寒冷中繼續發抖...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
謝謝

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
進入後，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
那麼請小心！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Kill 100 monsters regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Have you finished already? You've done it hotly as expected~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你已經完成了嗎？果然很厲害呢~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll do the rest of the research for you~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
那麼剩下的研究就交給我吧~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you for your hard work. I hope we can meet again!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
謝謝你的辛苦工作。希望我們下次還能見面！！

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你好，冒險者

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我是來自<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組的拉迪米爾。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我被派到了這麼陰沉的地方，說實話，我很害怕

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'd like you to conduct the investigation together, but... you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我想邀請你一起進行調查，但是...你還沒有加入調查組。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to do something meaningful with me?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你願意和我一起做一些有意義的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If you are interested, please meet <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and join the Investigation Team and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
如果你感興趣，請去見<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>，普隆德拉的指揮官，加入調查組後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你好，冒險者

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我是來自<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組的拉迪米爾。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我被派到了這麼陰沉的地方，說實話，我很害怕

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
But I've always been interested in the phenomenon of illusion, and when the investigation team was founded, I actively applied for membership.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
但我一直對幻覺現象很感興趣，當調查組成立時，我積極申請了加入。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Because nobody has figured it out yet
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
因為目前還沒有人弄清楚它

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
It's just the beginning of the current investigation, but it's sure to be a great first step
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
這只是當前調查的開始，但肯定是一個偉大的第一步

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Therefore, fear can be overcome by will.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
因此，恐懼是可以被意志克服的。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Investigation preparations are complete, now I'm waiting for someone who can adjust the monsters' levels.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
調查準備工作已經完成，現在我在等待能調整魔物等級的人。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
How about you, why don't you participate in the investigation? You joined the investigation team for that, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你呢，為什麼不參與調查呢？你加入調查組不就是為了這個嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'll stay here
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我會留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
只要在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
The sooner the better.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
那麼，我就等你了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That's it for today.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
今天就到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If the current trend, I think we can resume the investigation in a day or so. Please come then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
按照目前的情況，我想大概一天左右就能恢復調查。到時候請過來。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你好，你今天來是為了協助調查嗎？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Please execute the operation as it was then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
請按照之前的方式執行任務。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to participate in the task of killing 100 monsters of any type?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你要參與擊殺100只任意種類魔物的任務嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You acted meaninglessly, I'm disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你的行為毫無意義，我很失望。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
那麼，我就等你了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You came through quickly, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你來得真快，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That makes it easier to work out the numbers.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
這樣更容易計算資料了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I will finish the rest of the work soon and report it to the investigation team. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我會盡快完成剩下的工作並向調查組彙報。感謝你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我是來自<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組的瑪喬可~

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我真的很想被派到這裡來，不過運氣不錯。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
這些該死的泰迪熊~~ 泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... But you haven't joined the investigation team yet...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
但我做不到... 我的力量不夠... 不過你還沒加入調查組...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You can sign up by going to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera. Sign up and come here~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你可以去找<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>，普隆德拉的指揮官報名。報名後來這裡~

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我是來自<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組的瑪喬可~

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我真的很想被派到這裡來，不過運氣不錯。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
這些該死的泰迪熊~~ 泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... He looks easy... but he's so strong...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
但我做不到... 我的力量不夠... 他看起來很容易對付... 但他很強...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I thought I could do it all by myself... I took it too lightly... Huh...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我以為我可以一個人搞定... 我太輕視了... 唉...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I unknowingly and vigorously attacked and came back with a lot of beating... I almost died...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我不經意間猛烈攻擊，結果被打得很慘... 差點死了...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I barely recovered... I think it's possible to investigate, but you look a little strong?
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我勉強恢復了... 我覺得調查是可能的，但你看起來有點強？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Then help me... I need someone to take control of those vicious teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
那就幫幫我... 我需要有人來控制那些維舍斯泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
How about it? Do you want to join the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
怎麼樣？你想加入調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Yes... I'm about to collapse after I've been here... Like a man without blood or tears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
是的... 我在這裡快撐不住了... 像個沒有血和淚的男人...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Okay! Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
好的！我們走！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
去打敗大約100只，然後回來，不管什麼種類，看到就炸掉！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I... can't even move... Here... I'll wait...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我... 連動都動不了... 這裡... 我會等著...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Well, no more today
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
好了，今天就到這裡

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Come back after a day!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
一天後再回來！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Oh, nice to meet you! Welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
哦，很高興見到你！歡迎回來！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You must have come here because your body itches.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你一定是因為身體發癢才來的吧。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Would you like to participate in the investigation work here again today??
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你今天想再次參與這裡的調查工作嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
What...then why did you come??
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
那...那你為什麼還來？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Sure, that's how it should be
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
沒錯，本來就該這樣。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Regardless of the type, just beat 100 of them and bring them back.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
不管是什麼種類，只要打倒100只並帶回來就行。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'll be waiting for you, so hurry up!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我會在這裡等你的，快點回來！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
去打敗大約100只，然後回來，不管什麼種類，看到就炸掉！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I've been waiting for you... finish quickly and come back...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我一直在等你...快點結束然後回來...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Um...but that's about it... um...yeah!! good!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
嗯...不過大概就是這樣了...嗯...很好！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Leave the rest to me!! I'll report the results to the investigation team, now you can go and rest.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
剩下的交給我！！我會把結果彙報給調查組的，你現在可以去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Thank you~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
謝謝~~

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我是奧裡安，<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組的契約工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, it's not something I'm keen on...but I need the money...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
其實，我對這個並不太感興趣...但我需要錢...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
如果你能幫我就好了...可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
呃，但你還沒有加入調查組。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
請向普隆德拉的指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申請入會，然後過來！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我是奧裡安，<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組的契約工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
The Illumination Investigation Team is a newly formed organization, so it must have been a little understaffed. I saw an announcement that they would hire part-time contract workers.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查組是新成立的組織，所以人手肯定有點不足。我看到公告說他們會招募兼職契約工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, I'm not interested in illusions... I'm busy making a living.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
其實，我對幻覺並不感興趣...我正忙著謀生呢。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Huh... It's all about money, I'm going to buy a new set of clothes when I get paid.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
哈...都是為了錢，等拿到工資我就去買一套新衣服。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
But even that isn't easy... I've been waiting for an investigator like you to come because I think it's going to be very difficult on my own.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
但即使那樣也不容易...我一直在等像你這樣的調查員來，因為我覺得我一個人很難搞定。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
如果你能幫我就好了...可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Would you like to participate in this Illusion Investigation?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你想參加這次<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Ah... I finally found an investigator... Ah... I want money...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
啊...終於找到調查員了...啊...我想要錢...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oh, thank you
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
噢，謝謝你

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please go up one floor from here and go to the bleak Guyang Palace.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
請從這裡上去一層，前往荒涼的龜陽宮。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
And please kill 100 monsters there, regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
並且請在那裡擊殺100只魔物，不限種類。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'll be waiting for you here. Have a safe trip!!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我會在這裡等你。一路順風！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You're not fit to do research right now.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你現在不適合做研究。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I think it will be fine by tomorrow, can you come back after tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我想明天應該就沒問題了，你能明天之後再來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello, you are the only one who can help me...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你好，你是唯一能幫我的人...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
What we need to do is the same as last time...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我們要做的和上次一樣...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Are you going to help me with the illusion investigation again?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你要再次幫我進行<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參與

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Aigoo...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Sob.....
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
嗚...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oops... Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
哎呀...謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Go to the bleak archery and kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
去荒涼的射箭場，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Then be careful...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
然後小心點...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Destroy 100 monsters of any type in the bleak Archery.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
在荒涼的射箭場擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You came home safely.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你安全回來了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh... You took it down a lot faster than I expected.. You... you were a master??
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.

scripts.translation: 參與

scripts.text: Do not participate

接下來的工作由我自己來做。

Kill 100 monsters of any type.
